# goweb

> Noweb-style literate programming for GitHub Flavored Markdown.

goweb lets you write documentation and code in `.md` files, then tangle source, weave clean markdown, or render HTML.

Written with DeepSeek and Grok 4.6 (xAI).

## Links

- Source: https://github.com/xyzzyapps/goweb
- Docs (this site): https://xyzzyapps.github.io/goweb/
- Spec: https://github.com/xyzzyapps/goweb/blob/master/SPEC.md
- README: https://github.com/xyzzyapps/goweb/blob/master/README.md

## Commands

- `goweb tangle` — extract code chunks
- `goweb weave` — clean markdown
- `goweb render` — HTML (lit-lang.org palette, no underlines)
- `goweb index` / `goweb graph` — chunk map (use as LLM context before dumping files)
- `goweb tangle --match tag` — one tag shelf
- `goweb sync` / `goweb reverse` / `goweb init` / `goweb lsp`

License: CC BY-SA 4.0.

## Syntax (brief)

- `<<name>>=` … `>>` defines a chunk (`file:`, `pipe:`, `exec:`, `session:`, `tags:`, `override`)
- `<<name>>` references a chunk (weave/render: in-document link)
- `<<import "file.md">>` / `<<override "file.md">>` — `<<override>>` is not a chunk
- `<<if var>>` / `<<elif>>` / `<<else>>` / `<<end>>`
- `{{var}}`; `--var`; unset AUTHOR/EMAIL/REPO from git config
